missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Связь' is a soft-sign feminine noun in the nominative. 'Крепкая' is the agreeing feminine adjective and 'между ними' shows the parties connected.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Связь' is the accusative direct object of 'нашли'; soft-sign feminines keep the same form in the accusative singular. 'Важную' agrees and 'учёные' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive under negation. 'Связи' is the genitive after 'нет'; soft-sign feminines take '-и'. 'Мобильной' agrees in the feminine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Связи' is the dative form after 'уделяют внимание'; soft-sign feminines take '-и'. 'Этой' agrees and 'учёные' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after verb. 'Связью' is instrumental because 'дорожить' governs the instrumental case; soft-sign feminines take '-ью'. 'Тёплой' agrees and 'мы' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'В связи' uses the prepositional form 'связи' after 'в'. 'Этой' agrees and 'смысл' is the nominative subject after 'есть'.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Связь' is the feminine nominative subject. 'Между событиями' is an instrumental phrase showing what is linked, and 'очевидна' is the short-form predicate.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Связь' is the accusative object of 'потеряли'. 'С другом' is an instrumental phrase showing with whom contact was lost.

missions.phrase: У него хорошие связи в городе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Связи' is the nominative plural meaning contacts. 'Хорошие' agrees in the plural and 'у него' shows whose connections.

missions.phrase: Он добился успеха без всяких связей.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive plural after preposition. 'Связей' is the genitive plural required by 'без'. 'Всяких' agrees in the genitive plural, and 'он' is the subject of 'добился'.
